plain: Given or granted, as a gift or honor

webster.text: Given gratuitously; conferred; laid out; applied; deposited for safe-keeping.

example.quote: Is not the power, both over taxation and the militia, wrested from their hands by this Constitution, and bestowed upon the general government ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 27, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
